info.title: EduElderly Course Service
info.description: Catalog of categories, courses, modules, and topics. Public reads expose no lesson content URLs; admins manage content; other services read compact stats over internal routes.

tags.name: Internal
tags.description: Service-to-service endpoints. Require the shared `X-Service-Key`; not routed by the gateway.

get.summary: Get a published course with its curriculum

patch.summary: Publish or unpublish a course (audit logged)

get.summary: Get a course with full content including topic content URLs

delete.summary: Delete a module and its topics

post.summary: Add a topic (lesson) to a module

contentUrl.description: YouTube or article URL; only served to enrolled learners

get.summary: Catalog counts for the admin dashboard
Get a course regardless of publish state (enrollment, payment)
Compact course stats for progress calculation
Get a topic including its content URL (enrollment content gate)

bearerAuth.description: Access token from `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. The gateway validates it and forwards `X-User-Id` / `X-User-Role` to services.

serviceKey.name: X-Service-Key
serviceKey.description: Shared secret (`INTERNAL_SERVICE_KEY`) injected by the gateway or another service.

Topic.description: Public topic shape. `contentUrl` is never exposed here; learners fetch it through the enrollment content gate.

credits.description: Source attribution shown on the course page.

CourseStats.description: Compact summary used by enrollment to compute progress without duplicating course data.
